```mermaid
    a["Pbs Mill Medium Capsule"]:::current

    a --> b
    click b "/ja/content/items/pbs-mill-large-capsule/" "Pbs Mill Large Capsule"
    c["Pbs Mill Large Capsule Pr"]:::prod
    a --> c
    click c "/ja/content/items/pbs-mill-large-capsule-pr/" "Pbs Mill Large Capsule Pr"
    classDef current fill:#2f9e6f,stroke:#1f6f4a,color:#ffffff
    classDef prod fill:#3b6ea5,stroke:#274a75,color:#ffffff
    classDef more fill:#39445a,stroke:#54658a,color:#d5dbe8
```
